content.heat: The cargo overheats: one agent can keep it only for a limited time, then it jumps back to where it started. It counts again only when a different agent picks it up.
content.weight: Carrying the cargo slows you down.

hints: Deliver the cargo to the receptacle 'dock' (north-east corner).

briefings.A: Nothing in this map can make the task permanently impossible: mistakes only cost time (panels clear, pads push you back, doors close again). Other agents are invisible to you.
